research_role: article-level structured event extraction; no return forecast and no trading action
selection_basis: Operational correction after the v3.3 full extraction reached batch 5 and one model evidence span abbreviated intervening headline words with an ellipsis. V3.4 accepts ellipsis only when at least two nonempty fragments occur verbatim and in order, then copies the single covering substring from the frozen headline. Missing or reversed fragments still fail. Event fields, model, sample, prompt, response schema, batch size, seed, and gate thresholds are unchanged; no market outcome or trading result was consulted.

prior_operational_failure.reason: one model evidence span abbreviated intervening source words with an ellipsis, causing exact-substring validation to reject the four-item batch

stage1_gate.decision: all requirements must pass before full-corpus extraction

stage2_only_if_stage1_passes.scope: one full extraction over 39393 articles; no outcome join, predictive test, threshold selection, backtest, or Tech overlay

prohibited: changing prompt, schema, model digest, sample, batch size, or gate thresholds after Stage 1 begins
joining market outcomes before the full extraction artifact is complete and frozen
creating action, position size, or Tech overlay fields in the extractor
running more than one LLM worker
continuing compute at NVIDIA GPU temperature 75 C or above
